name: SpecsMap Plugin UI
description: UI sub-spec for the SpecsMap dependency graph visualizer: SVG edge rendering, node layout by layer, search/filter, detail panel, cycle analysis, and settings panel.

children: svg.sm-edges-layer (SVG path elements for dependency edges)

node.structure: .sm-node with header (layer-colored bar), name, source file, layer badge
node.sizes: 280x100 for feature nodes, 230x62 for UI sub-spec nodes

structure.detail_panel: .sm-panel (slide-in from right, 320px wide): shows full spec JSON

interactions.behavior: Highlights the node and its dependency edges; dims unrelated nodes
Opens detail panel with full spec data; shows source file link
Zooms in/out centered on mouse position
Filters nodes by name; highlights matching results with keyboard navigation
Focuses on the first/next search result node
Reloads all spec files from disk and rebuilds graph
Fits all nodes into visible viewport
Opens settings panel with layer visibility toggles

states.name: empty
states.description: No spec files found; shows empty state message

states.name: graph-loaded
states.description: All nodes and edges rendered; interaction enabled

states.name: detail-open
states.description: Detail panel visible showing selected node spec data

states.name: search-active
states.description: Search bar open with filter results highlighted

states.name: cycle-mode
states.description: Cycle analysis active showing dependency layers with colored highlights

states.name: isolated-mode
states.description: Only the selected node and its direct dependencies/dependents visible

states.name: validation-error
states.description: Validation badge shows count of broken references (dependencies with no matching spec)
